Cara is two slots from Finn and can't be H+3 (Ann's slot), so Cara is H+7. That fills H through H+7, so H ≤ 2. Ivo must be before Finn and at least three slots from Ann, which leaves only slots below H. The one open slot left over has to be Ivo's, so H = 2.
